---
name: Tool idea
about: Suggest a new tool for OmniTools
title: "[Tool idea] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What's the tool?**
A one-sentence description of what it does (e.g. "Crop images to specific aspect ratios").

**Why is it useful?**
Describe the real-world problem it solves and who would use it.

**How would it work client-side?**
OmniTools is 100% browser-based with no servers. Sketch how the tool would process input entirely in the browser (file APIs, canvas, text parsing, etc.).

**Similar tools to reference (not to copy)**
List any existing tools that inspired the idea — these are idea references only; the implementation must be native to OmniTools.

**Anything else?**
Any additional details, examples, or links that would help scope it.
